author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on canonical workspace propagation. Send/Sync contract on async-method futures is workspace-wide — every extension-client SessionClient has the same uncontracted concurrency posture. Same applies to base-client's JmapClient. Decision (typed-contract via bound, or doc-only assertion, or compile-time assert via fn _assert_send::<T: Send>()) lands at jmap-base-client + canonical mail-client first, propagates.
